Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候有一个人叫神农” / Formula: 在 + historical time + ，+ introduce character (name + role) / Correct: “在古代，有一个人叫神农。” “在古代” is more natural than “古代的时候.” You could also introduce him more clearly: “在古代，有一位想成为医生的人，叫神农。”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他需要当上医” / Formula: 谁 + 想/希望 + 成为 + 职业 / Correct: “他想成为一名医生。” “当上” usually emphasizes successfully obtaining a position, while “想成为” fits a personal goal better. “医” should be “医生” in modern Chinese.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一看别的人就想帮助他们” / Formula: 谁 + 一看到 + 人 + 就 + 想 + 帮助 + 他们 / Correct: “他一看到别人就想帮助他们。” Use “一看到” to mean “as soon as he sees.” “别人” is more natural than “别的人” here.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物” / Formula: 听说 + 在 + place + 有 + noun / Correct: “神农听说在一个很远的地方有一种植物。” The place needs “在” before it. “远远的地方” can be replaced with the more natural “很远的地方.”
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好” / Formula: 无论/任何 + noun + 吃了 + it + 都会 + result / Correct: “任何病人吃了它以后，身体都会好起来。” “什么病人” is not natural here. Also, use “它” to clearly refer to the plant.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方” / Formula: 谁 + 走了/花了 + duration + ，才 + 找到 + place / Correct: “神农走了三个月，才找到了那种植物生长的地方。” “走了三个月” shows the completed duration, and “才” emphasizes that it took a long time. “有植物的地方” is too vague because many places have plants.
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一个很漂亮的植物” / Formula: 一 + classifier + adjective + noun / Correct: “一种很美丽的植物。” The classifier for plants is usually “种,” not “个.”

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines a historical-time expression with 的时候, while “在古代” is correct.
“医” is not the appropriate modern word for a doctor here, and “想成为一名医生” is correct.
The correction improves 看 to 看到 but leaves “别人,” whereas the intended people are 病人.
“听说一个远远的地方有一种植物” is understandable and grammatical without 在, so this is not an error requiring correction.
The original needs the completed-action sequence “吃了以后,” and the corrected sentence supplies it correctly.
“三个月走去” has incorrect duration/aspect structure, while “走了三个月” is correct.
“个” is not an appropriate classifier for a plant in this context, and “一种很美丽的植物” is grammatical.
